title: 4 July 2015: Paul McCartney live at Roskilde Festival, Denmark
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Roskilde Festival in Denmark on 4 July 2015.

It was the 83rd show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015.

Big Bang! Roskilde! Tak! pic.twitter.com/z5aqLYxaDT

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) July 5, 2015

The setlist kicked off with The Beatles’ 1967 song ‘Magical Mystery Tour’. Another new addition was ‘Good Day Sunshine’, which McCartney hadn’t played since July 2008.

What a night at the Roskilde Festival. Thank you Denmark! pic.twitter.com/G8dzBUEP2H

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) July 5, 2015

Here’s the performance of Revolver song ‘Got To Get You Into My Life’ from the show:

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Backstage at Roskilde in Denmark w the inimitable Chris Holmes aka @ashtarchris -fire starter and MC… https://t.co/ZjX5O9pFfp

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) July 4, 2015

Backstage at Roskilde festival…birdboxes, so I had to "tweet" them. . . pic.twitter.com/grKuU8HIng

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) July 4, 2015
